name: Exp_VininI_Trend
summary: This EA trades based on the custom VininI_Trend indicator, which uses multiple smoothed moving averages with variable depths. It supports two entry algorithms: level breakthrough (BREAKDOWN) and direction change (TWIST), with configurable buy/sell permissions and position closing options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义VininI_Trend指标进行交易，该指标使用多层级平滑移动平均线。支持两种入场算法：水平突破(BREAKDOWN)和方向扭转(TWIST)，并可配置买卖许可和平仓权限。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是VininI_Trend指标，它通过多步深度递增的移动平均线平滑（MA_Step递增，MA_Count步数）后再经第二层平滑生成趋势信号。BREAKDOWN模式下，当指标值从下方突破UpLevel时产生买入信号，从上方突破DnLevel时产生卖出信号。TWIST模式下，当指标方向由下转上时买入，由上转下时卖出。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表存款比例。止损和止盈分别固定为1000点和2000点。EA仅在新增K线时检测信号（SignalBar=0除外），避免重复交易，同时支持分别控制开仓和平仓权限。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy centers on the VininI_Trend indicator, which generates signals by applying multiple smoothed moving averages with incrementally increasing depths (MA_Step increments over MA_Count steps), followed by a second-layer smoothing. In BREAKDOWN mode, a buy signal triggers when the indicator crosses above UpLevel from below, and a sell signal triggers when it crosses below DnLevel from above. In TWIST mode, a buy signal occurs when the indicator direction changes from downward to upward, and vice versa for sell signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Stop Loss and Take Profit are fixed at 1000 and 2000 points respectively. The EA only checks for signals on new bars (unless SignalBar=0), preventing repeated trades, and supports separate permissions for opening and closing positions.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金份额或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Trade funds percentage; negative for fixed lot

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 支持两种入场算法模式，灵活适应不同市场状态
买卖开仓和平仓权限可独立控制，便于精细化管理
使用新K线检测机制避免重复信号，减少过度交易
多层平滑算法有效过滤市场噪音，信号质量较高
指标时间周期可独立于图表设置，支持多周期分析
pros_en: Supports two entry algorithm modes (BREAKDOWN and TWIST) for flexibility across different market conditions
Buy/sell open and close permissions can be controlled independently for fine-grained position management
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated signals and reduces overtrading
Multi-layer smoothing algorithm effectively filters market noise for higher quality signals
Indicator timeframe can be set independently from the chart, enabling multi-timeframe analysis
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点为固定值，未根据市场波动性动态调整
缺少点差过滤和滑点保护机制，在高点差环境下可能不利
未检查是否已存在同方向持仓，可能导致重复开仓
MM参数正负逻辑不直观，容易造成误配置
依赖外部自定义指标VininI_Trend和SmoothAlgorithms.mqh库，可移植性较差
cons_en: Fixed Stop Loss (1000 points) and Take Profit (2000 points) are not dynamically adjusted based on market volatility
Lacks spread filter and slippage protection, which may be detrimental in high-spread environments
Does not check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially causing duplicate entries
The positive/negative logic of the MM parameter is unintuitive and prone to misconfiguration
Depends on external custom indicator VininI_Trend and SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library, reducing portability
improvements: 增加动态止损止盈机制，基于ATR或波动率自动调整
添加持仓检查和最大持仓限制，防止同方向重复开仓
增加点差过滤和交易时段控制，提升实盘稳定性
improvements_en: Add dynamic stop loss/take profit based on ATR or volatility for adaptive risk management
Add position check and maximum position limits to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction
Add spread filter and trading session control to improve live trading stability

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，在低波动期止损过大在高波动期止盈过小
未检查同方向已有持仓，可能导致加仓风险
MM参数负值手数逻辑容易误配导致过度杠杆
risk_points_en: Fixed SL/TP does not adapt to changing market volatility — SL may be too wide in low volatility and TP too tight in high volatility
No check for existing positions in the same direction may lead to unintended position accumulation
Negative MM value lot sizing logic is confusing and could result in excessive leverage if misconfigured
